visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand points at a yellow and red sign featuring a bear's face and multilingual 'No Entry' warnings. The background consists of a wooded area with dry leaves and a set of stairs. (2) A wide 360-degree camera angle captures a man in a green puffer jacket and black beanie driving a convertible through a dense green forest. (3) An aerial high-angle shot reveals a long gray railway bridge spanning a river, flanked by mountains covered in autumn foliage. (4) The man talks directly into a camera from the driver's seat of the car. (5) A digital interface appears showing a train timetable with green and white cells. (6) A screen recording shows a search on Google Maps for the 'First Tadami River Bridge' in Fukushima, Japan. (7) An animated map shows a travel route from Hakuba, followed by a POV shot of heavy rain hitting a car windshield on a highway. (8) A group of tourists with backpacks and cameras stands on a narrow wooden observation deck. (9) The man stands by a large lake or river under an overcast sky, looking out at the water. (10) Cinematic aerial shots follow a green and white train as it slowly traverses a large arched bridge over a river valley with fall colors.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 開車三百公里才發現景點竟然因為熊出沒而被封鎖. [Variety]: 熊 Bear 立入禁止 No Entry!! 禁止进入!! 출입 금지!!. (2) [Variety]: クマに注意!! 10月20日朝 ビューポイント頂上周辺で 熊の目撃情報がありました 十分ご注意ください AGGRESSIVE. (3) [Subtitle]: 這次自駕獨旅我打算前往號稱世界最浪漫的鐵道只見線. (4) [Subtitle]: 由於只見線一天只有幾班列車要提前算好列車經過鐵橋的時間建議還是自駕去拍攝點會比較容易. (5) [Variety]: 14:41 第一只見 4G 中華電信 桃園市大園區航站南路 Google 搜索第一只見川橋 記得要挑評價很高的那一個. (6) [Subtitle]: 我是從滑雪聖地白馬村出發路程需要開三百公里中間還有大量的山路還遇到了狂風暴雨. (7) [Variety]: 14:45 4G 白馬村 4小時1分鐘 收費路段 300公里. (8) [Subtitle]: 結果到拍攝點發現大家都帶著熊鈴其中一個拍攝點竟然還因為有熊出沒而直接封鎖. (9) [Subtitle]: 好在還有另一個拍攝點開放我們一群人擠在小小的平臺上等著列車出現. (10) [Subtitle]: 獨旅至此我已經度過了兩千多公里的翻山越嶺這才發現有些地方不是為了抵達而是為了等待. (11) [Subtitle]: 當列車出現時世界像是刻意放慢速度旅行不只向前走也是讓時間經過. (12) [Subtitle]: 哇 竟然開這麼慢.
